about: Receiving-water names in Tennessee's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for TN: the waters TDEC's HAB advisory layer names (the records read on 2026-11-07, with up to five of their points; rounded to 0.001 degree) and the 25 stream segments of TDEC's posted-streams list under a standing water-contact advisory (Rev. August 2026, 25 segments, with their counties). Spellings that differ only in case, spaces or punctuation are counted together. TDEC's Events Report names no receiving water. Names that are not a water's own ('pond', 'Unnamed (...)', a description of a place) are left out and counted in left_out.
